_readme: Approved route photographs. Torsten supplied these: four specific Commons files already chosen and checked by a person, with creator, licence and expected SHA256. This is not a search and not a filter - the fetch job takes these exact files by name and verifies the hash. A photo that does not match its recorded hash is refused, so nothing else can arrive in its place. Grossglockner has no approved photograph yet; it is recorded as pending rather than filled with a substitute.
